patterns.note: An asymmetrical, dynamic grid layout is used for portfolio items, mixing image-heavy and text-only cards of varying sizes to create visual interest and break from a uniform grid.

High-contrast accent colors, specifically a vibrant lime green and a bright teal/mint green, are used for hero backgrounds and prominent call-to-action banners against a largely neutral palette of light grey and dark text.
Headings are set in an extremely large, bold sans-serif typeface, creating significant visual impact and a strong hierarchy against smaller, well-spaced body text.
A prominent 'designers wanted' banner scrolls into view from the bottom of the page and then sticks to the bottom of the viewport, acting as a persistent, high-visibility call to action.
The site utilizes a full-width, high-contrast banner section that acts as a persistent call-to-action, sticking to the bottom of the viewport after it scrolls into view.

technique_notes: A sticky navigation element (hamburger menu) remains fixed at the top right of the viewport. A prominent call-to-action banner is designed to scroll into view from the bottom of the page and then adhere to the bottom of the viewport, providing a continuous, high-visibility prompt as the user scrolls through content.

An asymmetrical, flexible grid system is employed for displaying portfolio items, allowing for a mix of large image-based cards and smaller text-based entries. This creates a dynamic and visually engaging layout without strict column alignment.

The design leverages high-contrast color blocking, using a vibrant lime green for the initial hero background and a bright teal/mint green for a sticky call-to-action banner. These bold colors are strategically placed against a minimalist backdrop of light grey and white, with dark, impactful typography.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create strong visual impact, contrasted with smaller, well-spaced body text for readability.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous padding around sections and within the hero, contributing to a minimal and uncluttered feel, while the portfolio grid maintains a balanced density.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its bold use of high-contrast, almost neon, accent colors (lime green and bright teal) against a minimalist grey and white palette. This, combined with the dynamic, asymmetrical portfolio grid and the unique sticky bottom call-to-action banner, creates an energetic and modern feel that avoids generic design tropes.
